name: Glork

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description:
Metal rings woven together into a shirt, leggings, and a hood make up a suit of chainmail. Chainmail grants good protection, but it’s cumbersome, so it reduces your mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Chainmail grants +8 AC at levels 11-15, +9 AC at levels 16-20, +10 AC at levels 21-25, and +12 AC at levels 26-30.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

hit.description: damage (crit 1d12 + 14), and the target is marked until the end of Glork’s next turn

powers.name: Corrupting Strike
powers.description: targets an enemy marked by Glork

hit.description: damage, and the target is slowed and weakened (save ends both).

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target takes a -2 penalty to Fortitude until the end of Glork’s next turn

powers.name: Spawn Corrupt Minion
powers.requirements: while within 5 squares of a goblin mass

effect.description: Glork causes the goblin mass to spawn a corrupt goblin cutter. The corrupt goblin cutter appears in an unoccupied square adjacent to the goblin mass and makes a melee or ranged basic attack as a free action. Thereafter it acts immediately after Glork’s initiative count. Characters do not earn experience for killing corrupt goblin cutters summoned in this way.

powers.name: Goblin Tactics
powers.trigger: when missed by a melee attack
